offence_note: Common assault of wife and pointing a firearm
sentence_quote: Judge Embree imposed a 6-month term of imprisonment for the common assault concurrent to a 15-month term for the firearm's offence.
note: Forfeiture order for one gun set aside; rest of appeal dismissed.

offence_note: Robbery of taxi driver with co-accused
co_offenders: Pevach: 4 years imprisonment for aggravated assault
sentence_quote: I would reduce the custodial aspect of the sentence to one of 16 months.
note: Effective sentence about 31-32 months before credit; 16 months remaining; residential treatment probation condition added.

offence_note: Enticing a child under 14; dangerous offender
sentence_quote: The appellant was subsequently declared a dangerous offender and sentenced to an indeterminate period in custody.
note: Conviction and dangerous offender appeals dismissed.

offence_note: Two counts of second degree murder
sentence_quote: I sentence you to the mandatory sentence of life imprisonment. Pursuant to s. 745.4 of the Criminal Code, I order that your sentence of life imprisonment be served with no eligibility for parole for 20 years.
note: Parole ineligibility raised from 10 to 20 years, concurrent for both murders.

offence_note: Sexual exploitation of a sixteen-year-old employee
sentence_quote: He appeals his sentence of nine months’ imprisonment, followed by two years’ probation.

offence_note: Fraud over $5,000 and conspiracy to commit fraud
sentence_quote: The appellant was sentenced to an 18 month custodial sentence, followed by 2 years of probation.
note: Court said 18 months was very low.

offence_note: Possession of carfentanil and fentanyl for trafficking
sentence_quote: I would grant leave to appeal the sentence but dismiss the sentence appeal.
note: Ten-year sentence stated in paragraph 4; fresh evidence rejected.

offence_note: Conspiracy to produce and traffic methamphetamine, cocaine trafficking, proceeds of crime
sentence_quote: I would allow the appeal, set aside the sentence of 14 months' imprisonment for the two drug offences and substitute a combined sentence of five years and two months' imprisonment.
note: Majority view; dissent by Smith J.A. ignored. Crown appeal; 8 years less 34 months credit.

offence_note: Possession for trafficking of several drugs; firearms offences
sentence_quote: I agree that the joint submission that has been made to me is appropriate and I will impose the sentence as suggested by counsel.
note: Joint submission: six years less 336 days served at 1.5:1.

offence_note: Sexual offences against child, child pornography; breaches of recognizance
sentence_quote: For the sexual offences, he was designated a dangerous offender and sentenced to an indeterminate period of incarceration.
note: Breaches: consecutive 24-month sentences concurrent with indeterminate sentence.
